pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless existing trade has locked in at least +$5.00 profit via trailing stop.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce a mandatory ATR-based buffer zone of at least $1.50 away from recent swing highs/lows for initial stop placement to prevent noise hunting.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively scale out or lock trailing stops when floating profit crosses +$10.00 to ensure asymmetry hits the $15-$30+ target.
